copy.curiosityHook: When an ordinary cobbler gains the power to inhabit anyone whose shoes he mends, what will living as other people reveal about his own life?
copy.description: Weary of his daily routine in his family's generational New York repair shop, Max Simkin unearths a magical heirloom that lets him step into the lives of his customers and experience the city from new perspectives.
copy.vibeSummary: Engaged and thoughtful, mixing gentle fantasy with comedic warmth and grounded drama for an introspective solo watch.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Tom McCarthy, this offbeat fable blends comedy and urban drama, using a whimsical body-swapping conceit to explore identity and quiet self-discovery.

allowedMaterial: Max Simkin's role repairing shoes in a generational New York shop
Stepping into customers' lives and perspectives
excludedMaterial: Specific customer subplots or criminal entanglements
Endings or final revelations regarding the heirloom
